method.contest: Closest defender less than 4 feet, pooling 0–2 and 2–4 NBA buckets. Open pools 4–6 and 6+ feet.
method.groups: Two-point shots under 10 feet, two-point shots at least 10 feet, and all three-point shots.
method.matched_shooters: At least 10 attempts on both sides in the group. Both rates use the same shooter weights, n_contested*n_open/(n_contested+n_open).
method.parity: Open conversion divided by contested conversion. This equalizes expected make credit under this sample, not causal difficulty.
method.interval: Percentile interval from resampling shooters with replacement 2,000 times.
method.misses: Attempts include misses. Residual points on a shot = shot value × (made indicator − expected conversion in its group).
method.coverage: The four defender buckets and the unclassified residual reconcile to the unfiltered NBA counts for each player and distance. Unclassified attempts are excluded from rate calculations.
